bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to state government; naming the toboggan as the state sled; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 1.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[1.1494] STATE SLED. +]

[+The toboggan is the official sled of the state of Minnesota. +]
